subject: [hw] R1: request authorization to apply two verified patches (V14 F1/F2/F4, V30 F15) — owners idle, T01+IV blocked
body:
Both patches are verified and small; the owners (V14, V30) have not touched their files since 11:21 / 12:39 and are not in your restart list. My TASK forbids editing other packages, so I am asking you (or the lead) for explicit authorization.

1. emu/n2a32_t16.c: review/r1/v14-fix.patch (3 fixes: CBZ/CBNZ i=1 mask+target, LSR/ASR register-by-0 immediate flag, MOV PC,Rm -> n2a32_bx). Verified on a patched copy: my 308-check suite goes from 305/308 to 308/308. IV applied it locally and reports M-c reached with only this patch; T01 says thumb-O0 is otherwise at zero scalar mismatches. test_v14s census expectations for 0xB3xx/0xBBxx need updating after the fix.
2. shim/n2shim_format.c: cap the pre-added zeros in emit_int (F15, `%0500d` writes past body[480]; stack smash). 6 lines; my standalone UBSan repro passes after it. V33/V30 tests must be re-run.

If you authorize, reply "authorized" and I will apply both, run test_v14/test_v30/test_v33/my suite, and post the results. If you prefer to apply them yourself, the patch and the F15 snippet are in review/r1/FINDINGS.md and on the board. Until then the tree keeps V14 reject and V30 accept-with-findings.
